title: Micron 16GB DDR4 2133MHz dual-rank x4 configuration ECC Registered Server RAM

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your server performance with the Micron MTA36ASF2G72PZ-2G1A2 16GB DDR4-2133MHz ECC Registered Server RAM, built for speed, reliability, and efficiency.

This RDIMM module delivers outstanding performance with a data rate of 2133 MT/s, operating at a low 1.2V for improved energy efficiency.

Engineered with ECC (Error-Correcting Code) technology, it ensures maximum data integrity, making it an ideal choice for critical workloads in servers, workstations, and data centers.


The Micron MTA36ASF2G72PZ-2G1A2 features dual-rank x4 configuration and CAS latency CL15-15-15, optimized for advanced server applications requiring stability under heavy loads.


Whether you’re upgrading or maintaining your enterprise system, this Micron DDR4 RDIMM guarantees long-lasting reliability and consistent performance that Micron is known for.


Key Features:


  • Brand: Micron
  • Model: MTA36ASF2G72PZ-2G1A2
  • Capacity: 16GB (1x16GB)
  • Memory Type: DDR4 ECC Registered (RDIMM)
  • Speed: 2133 MHz (PC4-17000)
  • Voltage: 1.2V
  • Rank: Dual Rank x4
  • CAS Latency: CL15-15-15
  • Form Factor: 288-Pin RDIMM
  • Compatibility: Server-grade motherboards supporting DDR4 RDIMM
